about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

perform() reaches this only after a paragraph that is not its range's last returns; COTRN02C's PERFORMs each name one paragraph (from == thru) and MAIN-PARA (runTask's 0-17) always ends in RETURN / XCTL / an abend, so the scan over outer PERFORMs never runs

perform() reaches this only after a paragraph that is not its range's last returns; COTRN02C's PERFORMs each name one paragraph (from == thru) and MAIN-PARA (runTask's range) always ends in RETURN / XCTL / an abend, so the scan over outer PERFORMs never iterates

The final RETURN TRANSID(CT02) re-enters COTRN02C itself, and the next task is the only reader of the COMMAREA length (its EIBCALEN). COTRN02C uses EIBCALEN twice: IF EIBCALEN = 0 (line 115), false at 218 and at 219; and MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA (line 119), a 218-byte target, so the extra byte of 219 is truncated. DFHCOMMAREA is read nowhere else. The proof does not compare the length argument (a chained next-task run is not modelled), so this is stated from the program's own reads, proposed for owner review.

condition() returns a value only for a handled, ignored or ERROR-handled condition; COTRN02C sets no handler and an XCTL raises none ignored by default, so condition() throws (the abend) and `to` is never tested
COTRN02C never reads EIBRESP2 (or EIBRESP), so its value cannot show
every PERFORM of COTRN02C names one paragraph, so the fall-through return value is unused (same as the stated 946 / 947)
inside `if (0 != 0)`: the command has no RESP and the translator writes its response as the constant 0, so the block never runs
